summary:
CrowdStrike最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，年增率達25.83%。
• EPS實際達0.31美元，優於預期的0.29美元
• 營收達到14.7億美元，年增25.83%
• 核心資安訂閱業務需求保持強勁
• 營運效率提升帶動獲利能力改善
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健展現強大成長動能，然高達5000以上的本益比意味著市場已給予極高期待，短中期股價可能受高估值限制而震盪。持續追蹤指標為 ARR（年度經常性收入）成長率與大型企業客戶留存率。

需留意：本益比處於極高水準，估值壓力沉重；宏觀經濟不確定性可能影響企業資安IT支出預算

summary_en:
CrowdStrike reported quarterly revenue and EPS beating expectations, with revenue growing 25.83% YoY.
• EPS of $0.31 beat the estimated $0.29
• Revenue reached $1.47B, representing a 25.83% YoY increase
• Core cybersecurity subscription demand remained robust
• Improved operating efficiency drove better profitability

ai_view_en:
View: Solid financial results demonstrate strong growth momentum, but a trailing P/E above 5000 implies towering market expectations, which may cause near-to-mid-term stock volatility due to valuation constraints. Key metrics to track are ARR growth rate and enterprise customer retention.

Watch：Extremely high trailing P/E ratio presents severe valuation pressure; Macroeconomic uncertainty could impact enterprise cybersecurity IT budgets
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS與營收均擊敗分析師共識預估
